description: What the app’s merge tests send and read as Lo merges past a base branch’s rules, recorded from the app with writes on generation 7 of fixtures/merge.sh’s pull requests: Lo merged rozed-dev/e2e#231 into merge/7/override, past the “Merge override” ruleset’s required approval, as rozed-bot, an admin it lets bypass it, with ⌥⏎ and the number typed, with its tab open long enough for its polls to repeat before and after.
